# Economy Simulation Report

> ⚠️ **Out of date since Game Design Summary v3.4 (2026-11-12).** This report
> simulates the v1.1 economy. See the note at the top of
> [Economy, Progression & Rewards](Economy_and_Progression.md); the simulator is
> rebuilt for v3.4 in SCRUM-2.

*Generated by `Tools/EconomySim/simulate.py --report` from `Tools/EconomySim/economy.json`. Don't edit by hand: change the JSON and run the script again.*

Runs per player type: 200 (seeds 1–200). Bots are reasonable, not optimal: they collect, resend, summon whenever they can, spend cheapest-first, and fight the boss at 95% of its recommended power.

## Targets

| Check | Target | Result |
|---|---|---|
| T1 boss beaten in the first session (casual) | ≥ 60% of players (3 of 5 testers) | **100%** |
| T2 boss (casual, median) | 1–2 days after install | **41.5 h** |
| T3 boss (casual, median) | 2–3 days after T2 | **4.7 days (3.0 days after T2)** |
| Sessions with nothing to do | ≤ 10% | **0%** |
| Mine already full when a session starts | some, not most (it's the reason to come back) | **33%** |

## Playtest build (SCRUM-8)

One 45-minute sitting with every timer 10× faster (Mining, Expeditions, Guardian Tickets).

| Boss | Beaten by | Median time |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | 100% | 1 min |
| T2 | 14% | 42 min |
| T3 | 0% | — |
